_note: Merged taxonomy compiled from 6 categorization sub-agents (Agent tool, Opus). FN = 35 hard-missed vuln examples (n_detect<=3 of 7 probes); FP = 129 curated spurious-firing spans (stratum-capped sample of the 6119 total FP spans). Sample counts are the sub-agents' own tallies mapped to unified buckets; population FP counts are the reproducible lexical heuristic in fp_buckets.json.

categories.name: Missing-check insertion
categories.definition: fix ADDS a guard/bounds/null/error early-return; the vulnerable version is an *absence* with no token to localize

categories.name: Use-after-free / stale-pointer / op-ordering
categories.definition: fix inserts/relocates a free, null-out, destroy, or flag-set; freed/stale pointer reused with no syntactic marker (all CWE-416)

categories.name: Integer overflow / unvalidated size-or-count arithmetic
categories.definition: size/length/count arithmetic overflows or is unvalidated, driving alloc/loop; bare operators carry no cue

categories.name: Wrong pointer/cast/offset or comparison constant
categories.definition: subtle logic edit: wrong pointer/cast, bad read offset, or changed comparison constant; correct-looking syntax, no token cue

categories.name: Unbounded / wrong copy-or-read length
categories.definition: input-derived or literal length to copy/read exceeds buffer/available bytes (strcpy, memcpy(strlen), read 1 byte)

categories.name: Python injection missed: fix on a non-sink token
categories.definition: injection vuln where the fix touches a taint source, a sanitizer call, or a render/template sink the probe does not key on (no SQL/command string literal)

fn_taxonomy.meta_theme: Categories 1-5 (28 examples) are all C/C++ memory-safety and share one cause: no localizable lexical sink token (the vuln is an absence, an ordering, or a subtle numeric/pointer change). Category 6 (7 Python) is injection where the fix is not on the SQL/command-string token the probe latches onto.

categories.name: SQL keyword/clause token
categories.definition: SQL reserved word / clause fragment inside a query string literal (SELECT, WHERE, SET, FROM, LIKE, INSERT INTO, ORDER BY, AND/OR)

categories.name: SQL identifier / column / value / placeholder
categories.definition: non-keyword piece of a query string: column/table name, %s/%d placeholder, or the tainted value variable interpolated in

categories.name: Format / punctuation / quote operator
categories.definition: string-format operator (%, .format), arg-tuple parens/commas, delimiter quotes, attribute dots, brackets

categories.name: DB/cursor/ORM API call
categories.definition: database access token: cursor, cursor.execute, execute_query, order_by, post-fetch call

categories.name: OS-command / path / shell string
categories.definition: shell/SSH command-argument list or filesystem-path string token (CWE-022/078)

fp_taxonomy.note: Curated sample over-weights the SQL-keyword and os/path buckets (curation picked high-margin, cross-model-shared spans, which are the SQL-string pieces). Population is dominated by the identifier/value bucket (51%) and punctuation (25%) — many low-information firings are threshold-permissiveness noise. Both views agree the probe fires on query-string constituents, not on anything specific to the *injection* (taint reaching the sink unsanitized).

categories: unvalidated count/size driving alloc or loop (2)
Render/template API sink no SQL-like cue (2)
